title: OpenWA

short_desc.en: Send WhatsApp messages from your other apps.
short_desc.pt: Envie mensagens de WhatsApp a partir dos seus outros apps.

description.en: A WhatsApp API gateway — turns the account into REST plus webhooks, for n8n and Home Assistant to use
description.pt: Gateway de API do WhatsApp — transforma a conta em REST + webhooks, pro n8n e o Home Assistant usarem

author: rmyndharis
notes: While WhatsApp Web reloads its own page — measured around five minutes after a
fresh pairing — every engine route answers `409` instead of the raw `500` it
used to. A client that retries on 5xx and gives up on 4xx will now fail where
it used to recover, so check the flows that call this API.
